content.title: Tradeweb (TW) Q3 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
content.summary: Year-to-date revenues as of the third quarter were up 21% or 17% organically, putting us on track for another year of double-digit revenue growth. content.title: Treasury Yields Rise After Powell Pushes Back On Rate-Cut Bets
content.summary: Treasury yields rose further Wednesday after Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell said that an interest-rate cut in December was not guaranteed. The comment surprised traders, who have been betting that a December rate cut was highly likely.
